The RTL module boundary/interface checklist above is complete and directly usable for RTL top-level port review. It covers all major module boundaries, upstream/downstream interfaces, clock domain partitioning, reset tree structure (cold/warm/hot), PHY lane and reference clock topologies (all 3 modes), AXI/CFG channel dimensions with precise parameter values, interrupt aggregation paths, and key design rules extracted from the specification.

All evidence includes page numbers, figure references (Figure 3-1, 4-1, 4-2), and table references (Table 2-1, 4-1 through 4-6).
